issues.desc: Checklist items CHK-001 through CHK-004 are mostly framed as implementation mechanics rather than explicit user-observable outcomes. The INIT is still directionally ready because the background and CHK-005 identify the blocked Authority DONE preflight, but these items should more clearly tie completion to a recognizable user result such as signed DONE gate acceptance preserving materialOverlapAudit.
